info.name: Home Depot - Orange Charcoal | Dark
info.description:
This Theme pairs best with the browser extension Dark Reader.

A dark terminal-inspired shopping theme for homedepot.com and www.homedepot.com.
Warm orange accents, dark charcoal glass panels and a fixed CSS grid replace
large white page surfaces. Matching controls, search fields, category menus,
drawers, cards, product details, reviews, tables and scrollbars complete the look.
The original orange Home Depot logo gains a soft orange glow.
